semantics.labels: required units are pre-change patch sites (whitespace/import/docstring-only hunks dropped, new-definition placement demoted to complementary); they are not exhaustive relevance
semantics.recall: fraction of required units fully covered in the first k excerpts, over complete searches
semantics.fileRecall: fraction of edited files with at least one returned excerpt
semantics.complementaryCoverage: fraction of complementary units (tests, placement, audited context) overlapped by any excerpt; never counted as a miss
semantics.categories: change-localization uses the issue text; code-understanding asks for the function whose docstring is quoted
semantics.limitations: small public SWE-bench sample, issue text may name symbols; held-out means repository-held-out for tuning, not blind
